Overview

Working on HUD product where we are designing AR interface to help astronauts execute complex tasks in life-critical missions.

Project Structure

This is a research project where we are building an augmented reality (AR) interfaces for astronaut spacesuits, helping them perform spacewalks (EVAs) more effectively, especially for future Moon-to-Mars mission.

This project is currently underway. More details coming soon.
